theme: A clear calendar and a road south.
greeting: No meetings today, Dan — just miles. The real work is off the calendar: two holiday trips have slipped past their booking windows and are worth nailing down from the passenger seat.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Flagged p1 and overdue since mid-September. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the thinnest rental in that market — book it refundable now, before the holiday inventory is gone.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break destination
needsAttention.detail: Both gates — decide by Sept 30, book by Oct 15 — have passed, and holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year. Pick domestic or refundable-international and book it.

flagged.title: Board recruiter waiting on you
flagged.detail: A partner in a CEO & board-of-directors search practice pinged you on LinkedIn on the 19th and is still awaiting a reply — squarely on the board-seat track.

flagged.title: Tampa Gardens statement is up
flagged.detail: The monthly statement is available; payment is due by the 5th.

flagged.title: NACD New England run-of-show
flagged.detail: The run of show for the Oct 28 New England event you're on the list for went round yesterday — flag any edits when you're off the road.

inbox.noise: Dozens of promotions and newsletters — coffee and kitchen gear, menswear, travel miles, Zillow listings, local St. Pete news.

acts.line: Checkout in Fredericksburg and back onto I-95 — the long southbound middle of the drive.
Nothing on the calendar but open road; today the drive is the day.
The Coffee Pot Bayou cottage opens tomorrow — tonight is one more leg toward St. Pete.
